rounds.text: Guru Krupa Gems & Jewellery Ltd currently trades at a P/E ratio of 108x, which is significantly detached from the sector benchmark of 26.28x [E1, E6]. This valuation is increasingly difficult to justify given the company’s severe contraction in sales, which have plummeted by 80% over the trailing twelve months and 36% over the past three years [E16, E17]. The business is also failing to generate efficient returns on its assets, posting an ROA of 2.01% compared to the sector benchmark of 4.93% [E8]. Furthermore, the company provides no dividend yield to shareholders, offering no income buffer against these operational headwinds [E4]. Expectations are clearly running ahead of delivery, as evidenced by price growth exceeding profit growth by 108% [E46]. Conceded: [E18, E19, E57, E65, E66] show that the company has historically achieved long-term profit growth and currently benefits from positive sector tailwinds.
